definitions.explanation: A shop that specializes in selling fresh fish and seafood.

examples.japanese: {鮮魚店|せんぎょてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{刺身|さしみ}→刺身：04023_sashimi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: To buy sashimi at a fresh fish shop.

examples.japanese: ⟦{商店街|しょうてんがい}→商店街：09391_shoutengai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鮮魚店|せんぎょてん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧。
examples.english: The fish shop in the shopping street opens early in the morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鮮魚店|せんぎょてん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧⟦{新鮮|しんせん}→新鮮：03261_shinsen⟧な⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: Fresh fish is displayed every morning at the local fish shop.

notes:
⟦{鮮魚|せんぎょ}→鮮魚：16483_sengyo⟧ (fresh fish) + ⟦{店|てん}→店：10011_ten⟧ (shop). A traditional shop type found in shopping streets and markets throughout Japan. While supermarkets have largely replaced them for everyday shopping, {鮮魚店|せんぎょてん} remain popular at markets and in areas near fishing ports for their superior quality and expert knowledge.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鮮魚店|せんぎょてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧ — buy at a fish shop
- ⟦{老舗|しにせ}→老舗：16152_shinise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鮮魚店|せんぎょてん} — long-established fish shop
- {鮮魚店|せんぎょてん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店主|てんしゅ}→店主：12451_tenshu⟧ — fish shop owner

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{魚屋|さかなや}→魚屋：14642_sakanaya⟧ — fish shop; fishmonger — the everyday, colloquial term
- ⟦{鮮魚|せんぎょ}→鮮魚：16483_sengyo⟧ — fresh fish — the product itself
- ⟦{魚市場|うおいちば}→魚市場：27120_uoichiba⟧ — fish market — a larger wholesale or retail market for fish
